name: Case law: United States, the United States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit
label: United States case law (the United States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit)
coverage: 68476 published decisions, one file each, dated the day decided: 68470 with their opinion text and 6 with CAP head matter only (CAP holds no opinion text for them); 2665 citations of the US Code linked to united-states/federal/usc.
record_note: Court decisions, not laws: every commit is Kind: court. In-force is the day decided. Commits before 1970 are dated 1970-01-01, a second apart; In-force holds the real day. The US Code record holds only some titles, so most statute citations are not linked.

source.publisher: Caselaw Access Project (Harvard Law School Library)

overlay.reader: tools/usc_cite.py: a page stamp ("USCA4") is no citation, "(a)(4)" a subsection, "§§ 1-16" a range read at its two ends; a citation under an older numbering (before the title was recodified, before the section was added, an earlier edition, "former") is not linked; one row per decision (decision-relations.tsv duplicates left out)

appended.reporters: F.2d, F.3d, F. App'x, F., B.R., Am. Tribal Law, U.S., Colo. L. Rep., F. Cas., Ohio Law Abs.

relations.same-decision-as: the file is the same decision as the target (same day, docket or name, and text); both are kept
relations.moved-to: the decision was routed here by mistake and is now at the target (<repo>/<path>); this file was removed

decision_dates.note: decisions whose CAP date gives only the month or the year (precision month or year): committed on the first day of it, In-force likewise
